name: Pixel Art: Character Headshot
description: Image preset for a character headshot in the Pixel Art look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a headshot. Lead with the character's defining facial features, hair, and expression from the entity, then apply the style. Keep the background plain.
context_prompt: head-and-shoulders portrait of the character, face fills the frame, eyes sharp, neutral background that does not compete, pixel art, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited 16 to 32 colour palette, readable silhouette at low resolution, no anti-aliasing, deliberate dithering, single consistent light direction, high-contrast outline against the background
negative_prompt: smooth gradients, anti-aliasing, blur, photorealistic, 3d render, mixed pixel sizes, text, watermark
